client: I've been feeling really overwhelmed by my new job at the marketing agency. therapist: It sounds like you’re feeling quite overwhelmed and perhaps a bit discouraged with your new job. Let’s explore those thoughts together and find ways to build your confidence, as well as how therapy can support you through this challenging transition.
vocal_descriptors: very high pitch, soft-spoken, moderate-paced speech
